name: devlog-claude
description: Summaries of work by Claude: pick a canvas and a period in the side panel, and Claude writes up what was done there from the notes, todos and commits written on it and the time recorded; add it to the canvas as a block. Sends only that period's blocks to Anthropic, and only when you ask. Needs an Anthropic API key.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: Claude Opus 5.5 unless you choose another.

settings.label: Effort
settings.description: How much thought goes into each summary.

settings.label: API address
settings.description: Leave empty for Anthropic's API. Set it only to go through a gateway.

secrets.label: Anthropic API key
secrets.description: Create one at console.anthropic.com → API keys. Kept in this computer's keychain, never in the devlog.
